title: 84. Largest Rectangle in Histogram

examples.explanation: The adjacent bars of heights 5 and 6 form an area of 10.
In [2, 4], the bar of height 4 alone covers the largest area of 4.
In [2, 2, 2], all three bars can form a rectangle of width 3 and height 2, giving area 6.

hints: Keep indices of bars in non-decreasing height order on a stack.
When a shorter bar appears, pop taller bars; the current index determines their right boundary and the new stack top determines their left boundary.
